free_tier.stated: No total storage quota, no per-account package cap ('Unlimited public packages' — npm Pro page), no cap on versions per package. The only bounds are per-artefact and per-packument: empirically ~200 MB per tarball (no documented figure anywhere) and 100 MB per *packument* (the accumulated metadata document for all versions of one package).

retention.stated: | Append-only and durable — 2018 tarballs still serve with the original Last-Modified

egress.terms: Free and unmetered, Cloudflare-fronted. Probe: GET of a 70 MB tarball returned Server: cloudflare, Cache-Control: 'public, immutable, max-age=31557600', Accept-Ranges: bytes; ranged GET returned 206 Partial Content. No auth, no signed URL, no expiry.

tooling: Two-verb REST: PUT /:pkg with a JSON body containing base64 _attachments (or the standard npm publish flow), GET /:pkg/-/:pkg-:ver.tgz for the blob. Named clients: npm CLI, libnpmpublish (github.com/npm/libnpmpublish), and purpose-built chunking wrappers — gist github.com/yulioaj290/e81d3a59ec00247f00ec34db378fae6c (shell script that splits a file into N MB chunks, publishes each as its own npm package, adds the rest as dependencies of chunk 1, and emits an unzip script), indexzero/npm-publish-split-stream (4 stars, streams a publish request without buffering). No rclone backend.
chaining: UNBOUNDED: unlimited packages per account (Pro page: 'Unlimited public packages') x unlimited versions per package (bounded only by the 100 MB packument, ~763 versions for a 131 KB manifest — so keep manifests tiny and use many packages, not many versions of one package) x ~200 MB per tarball. Free accounts are per-email and per-GitHub-identity, so identities multiply the publish-rate ceiling, not the space ceiling.
limits_note: ~200 MB per tarball (413 Payload Too Large above that: one reporter hits it at 200 MB, pretendard's 229.9 MB tarball was rejected with E413; a 70 MB tarball serves fine). 100 MB per packument before compression — this is a *version-count* cap, not a byte cap. Publish is rate limited (429s reported in CI, github.com/npm/cli/issues/8507); exact rate not published. Versions are immutable and cannot be deleted after 72h unless the package has <300 weekly downloads and a single maintainer (unpublish policy). An unpublish frees the name's version slot only for new versions, never reuses a version string.

reliability_note: Append-only and durable — 2018 tarballs still serve with the original Last-Modified. Two hard failure modes for a bulk workload: silent 413 at ~200 MB (undocumented, so budget 150 MB), and packument bloat refusing all new versions for the whole package once it crosses 100 MB. Automated mass publishing gets 429'd.
